claims.evidence: No brand or model is legible; photos cannot show industrial strength.

No warranty document is visible in the photos.

risks.risk: Iron does not heat or produce steam
risks.proof: Video of the iron switched on, heating, and emitting steam.

risks.risk: Power cord is frayed or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full cord and plug.
Video of the tank filled and the iron steaming without leakage.
Video showing heat response across temperature settings.
Video demonstrating auto-shutoff after the iron is left idle.

risks.risk: Age or usage history is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of a receipt or any legible label showing purchase date.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used with unknown age

proof_requests: Video of the iron heating and producing steam
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug
Video showing no water tank leakage
Photo of any receipt or label for age
response.reason: The witness identifies a steam iron, so it can be priced at its worst case despite untested functions; the seller's claims are not proven by the photos.
